en: Red alert! This is bad! We\nare in serious trouble!

An ultra-massive
gravitational force is being
generated in the vicinity
of the ship! It is on the
scale of...a black hole.

A black hole!? Does that
mean that the ship is
about to be swallowed
up?

Yes, that certainly is a
possibility! What a
mysterious phenomenon...
A black hole appearing out
of nowhere!

What is going on!? Do you
think it might be...some
kind of gh-ghost!? I
cannot stand gh-ghosts!

Maybe it is like a whirlpool
in space― a black hole
that sucks you into a
place that is full of
monsters! Eek, too scary!
It sounds like a joke, but\nthe more I think about it,\nthe more it scares me.

Okay! I am sorry. Let us
get out of here, if we can.
...Do not get your hopes
up!

Coro, don't give up! The
Captain's life is at stake,
and that goes for the rest
of us, too!
Right, you're right! We\nhave to try, for everyone's\nsake...
Arrrgh! It is no use! The\ngravity is pulling us in!
...Captain, Captain!

Good morning! Your vitals
were normal, but when you
did not wake up I got
worried!

It has been a long time
since I have seen you so
surprised! You are wearing
the same expression as
you did that time we
crash-landed on that
planet saving Eve.

Not once, but twice! It
looks like barely escaping
death together is our fate,
Captain!

There'll be time for
reminiscing later. First
things first... Where the
heck are we?

As you can see, we've
crash-landed on a planet...
An uncharted planet,
perhaps?

...Huh? Some of our
instruments are
malfunctioning. I cannot
get our exact location.

The environment outside
seems safe, but to learn
more, I think we'll have to
go outside and explore
the surface...

In that case, the Captain
and I will go have a look
around. Looks like there
are buildings nearby.
Let's go, Captain. Coro,\nyou focus on repairing the\nship.

Aye aye! And remember to
keep an eye out for
dangerous life-forms, all
right?
This seems to be an\nuninhabited, hilly region...
Hey, that looks like a\nperson! They're being\nchased by something.
Rrk! Surrounded!
They're getting closer... No\none can take on that\nmany enemies alone.

Wait, what is that!? That
person's being attacked
by some clearly dangerous
creatures!
Of course we have to\nhelp!
Wha―!?
Are you okay? We can\nbeat them if we fight\ntogether!
Sorry about that. Thank\nyou.
You saved me. My name is\nAngelica. I serve in the\nAquarian army.

We saved each other. It
was the right thing to do.
I'm just glad we were able
to help out.

Why are you in a place
like this? Are you
Glyphians? Or are you
from Aquaria?
We're from Aquaria.
We're from Airyglyph.
We're royalty from the\nBanana Kingdom.

Oh, really? I'm Aquarian,
born and raised, and I've
never seen you around
before...

Seeing how strong you
are, I'd say you have to be
members of the castle's
Runological Unit.
I see. Glyphians...

I never thought I'd be
rescued by people who
were my sworn enemies
not so long ago... The
times are certainly
changing.

What did you say? The
Banana Kingdom!? What a
strange─ Apologies for my
rudeness, Your
Highnesses.
Um, I know we're hiding\nour true identity, but\nseriously?
And no offense, Captain,\nbut you're not exactly\nregal, are you?

Huh? Are you from the
continent of Greeton?
That would explain your...
unusual attire.

Ah well, it doesn't matter
where you're from. All I
know is that you're the
people who just saved my
life.

I wonder if you might help
me one more time. Would
you be willing to take part
in a defense operation at
the Kirlsa Training
Facility?
Well, we've come this far―\nmight as well hear the\ndetails.

Thank you for your
cooperation. I'll introduce
you to the Acting
Commander. Please follow
me.

Ah, hello. I am Farleen,
Acting Commander of this
operation. It will be an
honor to fight by your
side.

And I am Acting
Vice-Commander Tynave.
Thank you for saving
Angelica.

Both Aquaria and
Airyglyph are currently
under attack by swarms
of unidentified creatures.

They actually have the
nerve to call themselves
"Divine Messengers" to
those of us who worship
Apris.

Alas, not only are they
strong fighters, but they
also have overwhelming
numbers as well. We need
to find a way to deplete
their forces.
This Kirlsa Training Facility\nserves as a fortress to\ndefend the town.

If we can hold them off
around here, we can keep
them from reaching the
town. Instead, they should
change course...

If we can lead them into
the valley, we can smash
them to pieces with a
Runological weapon called
the "Thunder Arrow"! Blam!
And there you have it.

(She doesn't look like
much, but she doesn't
mess around when it
comes to tactics...)
So we'll fight by their side.\nI knew you'd be game,\nCaptain.
Thank you! All right, get\nready to fight, and then\ncome take up your post.

You can count on me, too!
I'll destroy as many of
these insolent, self-
described "Divine
Messengers" as I can!
With Commander Zelpher\naway, the defense of the\nkingdom falls to us...
We did it! The enemy is\nretreating!

I'm not sure whether or
not the threat is truly
gone, but we can rest at
ease for now.

You have our thanks. We
could not have achieved
this victory without your
help!
I just wish Commander\nZelpher could have seen\nus fight...

Commander Zelpher went
after the enemy with Fayt
and the others and aren't
back yet... I wonder where
they are now?

No matter where she is,
I'm sure Commander
Zelpher will return. After
all, she's our Commander...
Farleen! Tynave! Mission\naccomplished!
Dominic, what's wrong?\nIt's not time for the status\nreport yet.

I bear a message from the
Runological Weapons Unit.
The enemy forces lured
into the valley have been
wiped out by the Thunder
Arrow!

Not only that, thanks to
the courage of the
Glyphian forces, damage
to Kirlsa and the
surrounding cities was
minimal.
*Sigh...* I see your\noperation was a success,\ntoo. That's a relief.
Um... You mean...about\nyou?

I heard that an unknown
mercenary unit appeared
out of nowhere to help
with the Kirlsa Training
Facility defense operation.
A kitchen girl has been\nspreading rumors of "some\ncool stranger."
And so all the girls in town\nhave been abuzz with talk\nof you mercenaries.
We're just doing our job.
So, what were we\nfighting?
Introduce me to these\ngirls.

Your job... It shames me to
think that we used to fight
each other as neighboring
countries.

Spoken like a true hero of
justice, appearing just
when we need you most.
Who are you, really?
...Heh. Guess you're not\ngoing to just tell us, huh?\nHahaha.
It's a complete mystery.\nOur intelligence network is\nat a loss...

All we know is that they
refer to themselves as
"Divine Messengers," and
are also known as
"Executioners"...
A strange enemy indeed.\nTo be honest, I'm not even\nsure that they're alive...
Hmm. Whatever... At least\nnow the girls in town will\nbe impressed!

Hot words exchanged
between boys and girls in
the freezing cold of
Airyglyph. I like it!

Don't fall for any sneaky
tricks, Captain. We're not
done with our travels,
remember?

Heh. This was supposed
to be a simple report.
Let's leave it at that. I'll
return to my duties now.
It looks like operations are\nwinding down. Let's head\nout, too.
Captain! Captain!

I've finally restored
communications! How
much longer will you and
Eve be exploring the
area?

There was a battle
nearby, and an incredible
flash of light off in the
distance! You have no
idea!
I was so worried about\nyou, Captain. I was about\nto overflow with worry...
Sounds like Coro is\noverjoyed to hear your\nvoice again, Captain.
Is the rest of the ship\nrepaired, too?

Yes! Not just
communications, but all
other ship functions are
nominal!

The replicator works
again, and I have been
using it to make a bunch
of yummy bananas!

Oh, there are bananas
waiting for us. Better
hurry back to the ship,
then. Now we'll be able to
learn about this planet!
And so this story comes\nto a close.
The next part of this SO3\nevent story will be\navailable at a later date.
